description: Docs pages whose tests .github/workflows/doc-tests-pages.yml runs. To test a new page, add it here and add its page and watch paths to the workflow's push paths (a unit test checks they match). slug names the page's issue label (doc-tests-<slug>), artifacts, and sample doc types; watch lists the other files its tests depend on; timeout_minutes bounds its test step; secrets lists the secrets its run gets (default: SENSIBLE_TEST_API_KEY only); gate: false runs it on any change to the page (default true: prose-only changes skip it); propose_fixes opens a draft PR that rewrites drifted output; envelope_issue keeps a standing issue for LLM envelope warnings. Pages with UI tests get Doc Detective automatically.
